meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 装上后，项目会新增 Google Chat 适配器并注册到系统，安装固定版本的依赖，构建并运行测试。配置好 Google Cloud 凭证和公开的 Webhook 地址后，就能在 Google Chat 的空间或私聊里收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求为当前项目添加 Google Chat 通道支持，或在设置流程中选择接入 Google Chat 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目添加 Google Chat 通道
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 集成 Google Chat 后如何配置凭证？
say.note: 引导你完成 Google Cloud 控制台的服务账号设置。

say.text: 把 Google Chat 接到默认代理组

howto.what_en: After installation, the project gains a Google Chat adapter that is registered, installs a pinned dependency, builds, and runs tests. Once credentials and a public webhook URL are configured, messages can be sent and received in Google Chat spaces or DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Google Chat support to the current project, or during a setup flow when choosing to integrate Google Chat.

say_en.text: Add a Google Chat channel to this project
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter, registering, and installing dependencies.

say_en.text: How do I configure credentials after integrating Google Chat?
say_en.note: Guides you through service account setup in Google Cloud Console.

say_en.text: Connect Google Chat to the default agent group
